title: a trust claim does not give started async work an owner
notes: specification/requirements.mdx, 'Scoping' (Locked): "Imported JavaScript or TypeScript that starts hidden background work owns that work. Caller-controlled background APIs MUST expose explicit completion or disposal handles through their adapters." An async callback handed to a synchronous registration starts work nobody waits for, and the marker on the callee says nothing about it — the claim is that the CALL does not throw, not that a promise the callback returns is anyone's. The second of the three guards that keep 09-foreign-calls/a-callback-registered-through-a-trusted-binding-is-accepted narrow.
